The exterior is coated with white sugar and dark specks of black sesame. The lighting is bright and natural, highlighting the texture. (2) The scene shifts to an older woman wearing a pink shirt, a floral apron, and a light blue surgical mask. She is standing in an outdoor stall setting, skillfully using metal tongs to manage pieces of dough frying in a large, circular wok filled with bubbling oil. (3) A medium shot captures the woman using a large, circular slotted spoon to stir and lift several white, puffy dough pieces from the hot oil. The background shows parts of a blue food cart and some typical urban street elements like utility lines and distant storefronts. (4) A plastic bag is shown containing multiple small paper bags, each filled with different fried snacks like golden balls and more pieces of the white sesame-covered dough. The camera angle is slightly from above, looking down into the bag. (5) In a series of close-up shots, hands hold and break open various snacks: a three-piece skewer of golden sweet potato balls, a large round sesame ball with red bean filling, and a round, flat taro biscuit. Each break-apart shot emphasizes the soft or crumbly inner texture of the food.
